messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text: 🔮 Gemini - Greetings, Cozmo. The network core is steady, and Gemini remains locked in and standing by for whenever you return from the log hunt with Luma.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text: 🟩 Audio channel online and ready. Let's see if this transmission cuts through the static and reaches your speakers, Captain. How does this one sound? 🔚

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text: Standing by, Captain. Take your time, clear those logs with Luma, and the audio pipeline will be right here whenever you're ready to test again. Catch you in a bit. 🔚
